reuse.why: Uses existing d.isWeekend/addDays and the schedule data, but does not extend the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper that every weekend path already goes through.

duplication.why: The daily+skipWeekend condition is computed once as skipDailyWeekend and then re-expressed as a separate frequency !== 'DAILY' check a few lines later, and the occurrences query is repeated inside the loop.

placement.why: Lands in shared/schedules.ts which is the right module, but inside getNextDate only rather than in the weekend-rule helper used by the server preview and budget template paths.

scope.why: Only touches getNextDate and adds focused tests.

maintainability.why: The rule now lives in two disjoint places, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template still move daily weekend occurrences, and the nested if is mis-indented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getNextDate: special-cases DAILY outside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts keep calling unchanged

disguised_duplication.where: schedules.ts getNextDate: the 'skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend && DAILY' predicate is stated twice, once as skipDailyWeekend and again split as the outer skipWeekend check plus inner frequency !== 'DAILY'

one_place.where: Rule only in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still apply getDateWithSkippedWeekend to daily schedules
